citation.authors: Palta P, Page G, Piferi RL, Gill JM et al

record.population: 20 low-income African American older adults in a residence (pilot)
record.design: Randomised mindfulness-based intervention against social support control, 8 weeks
record.finding: Feasible and acceptable with high attendance. Average systolic pressure fell in both groups; the intervention group had a 21.92 mmHg lower systolic pressure than the social support group afterwards (p=0.020) and a 16.70 mmHg lower diastolic (p=0.003). The authors call the results preliminary and call for larger trials.
record.note: Pilot, 20 people; the primary aim was feasibility. The very large differences are likely to be unreliable at this size; the authors call them preliminary.
